device_filtering_mechanism.description: The device filter is an Input Control Visualization that creates a dropdown picker for flow.export.ip.addr
how_it_works: Populates dropdown with unique values from flow.export.ip.addr field
Supports multi-select for filtering multiple devices simultaneously
When Apply is clicked, adds filter pills to dashboard
All panels update to show only flows matching selected exporter IPs
Filter is global across allvisualizations in the dashboard
Works with time range filter for temporal analysis
